title: The Wire Season 1 - McNuggets
summary: A two-minute clip from The Wire season 1 in which D'Angelo explains, using the McNugget, that having an idea does not get you paid. It is a short monologue about who profits from inventing something.
why: HN posts it as a classic scene whenever threads touch on ideas versus execution or who captures the profit from invention.

quote.text: this classic monologue from The Wire is too good not to revisit
